summary: Meridian3 Industrials Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing that commencing August 24, 2026, holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and redeemable warrants. Units not separated continue trading as MIACU; separated shares and warrants trade as MIAC and MIACW. Each whole warrant exercises at $11.50 per share. Continental Stock Transfer serves as transfer agent; brokers must contact it to effect separation. This is a routine SPAC unit-split mechanics notice, not a special situation; watch for trust-redemption and de-SPAC timeline pressure.
